class.name: NetworkWriter
class.brief_description: Build a bounded binary gameplay payload from typed fields.
class.description: Create a writer with [method create], write fields in schema order, then seal the payload with [method finish]. Integers and floats use fixed widths and little-endian byte order. A string or byte array starts with an unsigned 32-bit byte length. The first error prevents later writes. This class writes payload bytes for a game-selected transport or storage path.

method.name: create
method.description: Allocate a writer with a payload budget from 0 through 1,048,576 bytes. Inspect [method get_error] for an invalid budget or allocation failure.

method.name: write_bool
method.description: Write one byte, with 0 for false and 1 for true. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_u8
method.description: Write an unsigned 8-bit integer from 0 to 255. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_u16
method.description: Write an unsigned 16-bit integer from 0 to 65,535. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_u32
method.description: Write an unsigned 32-bit integer from 0 to 4,294,967,295. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_i8
method.description: Write a signed 8-bit integer from -128 to 127. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_i16
method.description: Write a signed 16-bit integer from -32,768 to 32,767. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_i32
method.description: Write a signed 32-bit integer from -2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_i64
method.description: Write a signed 64-bit integer in the full Godot integer range. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_f32
method.description: Write a finite IEEE-754 binary32 float. The value rounds to binary32 precision. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_f64
method.description: Write a finite IEEE-754 binary64 float. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_string
method.description: Write a UTF-8 string preceded by its unsigned 32-bit byte length. The string may be empty. A leading byte-order mark and embedded zero codepoints are rejected. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: write_bytes
method.description: Write a byte array preceded by its unsigned 32-bit length. Return [constant OK] or the first writer error. A sealed writer returns [constant ERR_LOCKED].

method.name: get_error
method.description: Return the first writer error, or [constant OK]. Exceeding the byte budget returns [constant ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY]. An out-of-range numeric value returns [constant ERR_PARAMETER_RANGE_ERROR].

method.name: get_size
method.description: Return the number of accepted payload bytes before sealing or failure.

method.name: finish
method.description: Seal the writer and return its complete payload. On failure returns empty bytes. An empty message can succeed, so check [method get_error] to distinguish the two. Repeated calls return the same payload.
